anchor: Which magical stick holds seven uses of an explosive ball of flame that refills at sunrise, but might crumble after its last use?
What treasure recovers a handful of uses every dawn, and what happens to it if its final use is spent and a d20 shows a 1?
Which high-level magic lets me touch a friend so they get a boost on rolls for eight hours, making foes miss them more?
What one-minute casting needs a hummingbird's feather and lets a touched ally's enemies have trouble landing blows on them?
A monster gulped me down, and I've been hurting it from inside. If I deal 30 harm in one round, what happens to everyone it gulped?
When a belly-swallowing beast dies, can someone trapped inside get out, and how far must they move to get free?
Which blade gives a +3 boost to hits and damage, adds shining harm against demons and the undead, and shields nearby friends from spells?
Once a devoted warrior has reached seventeen levels, how far does the protective bubble around them and their friends extend while they hold a magic sword?
Which touch-based remedy can lift a hex, undo being turned to stone, or restore lost ability points, and eats up diamond dust worth 100 gold?
What spell can remove a level of weariness and undo a lowering of someone's maximum life total, if I have a fifth-level slot and can touch them?
Is there a gooey ointment that protects a friend from being held for eight hours, or one poured on the floor to make foes slip?
How long does it take to coat an average-sized adventurer and all their gear in a greasy liquid, and do bigger creatures need more bottles?
Which casting turns the greenery in a wide area into a thick tangle that makes creatures spend four feet of movement for every foot they travel?
Is there a long ritual that makes crops across half a mile yield twice the usual food for a year, and can it be repeated that year?
Which neck-worn trinket holds five uses for sensing what others are thinking, and refills one to four of them each dawn?
If I can probe someone's thoughts through a worn ornament, what target number must they beat on a roll to shrug it off?
Which drink lets me scale walls at my full walking pace for an hour, with an edge on the strength checks for scaling?
What liquid comes in layers of brown, silver, and gray that look like banded rock, and does shaking it blend them?
Which level-one jinx adds 1d6 life-draining harm to each of my hits and makes one ability I pick harder for the victim to use?
Can I move a jinx onto someone else on a later turn with a quick extra action, if the creature I've jinxed drops to zero?
Which at-will spell lets me make an arm's-reach strike for 1d10 life-draining harm, stopping the victim from healing until my next turn?
Starting from one ten-sided die, how many dice does my life-draining hit roll once I hit level seventeen, and at which levels does it grow?
Which wicked keepsake burns anyone who isn't a demon or undead when they grip it, and can split the ground under a foe 120 feet away?
Does a dark keepsake that gives my magical strikes a plus-two bonus stay intact after its last use, or dissolve into a stinking sludge?
After I land a sword or fist blow, can I spend a quick extra action to add 2d8 of shining damage, with more against demons and undead?
Does using a bigger magical slot after a sword strike add more shining harm, and how much per level above the lowest?
Which casting lets up to eight willing allies talk mind-to-mind over any distance for an hour, whether or not they share a tongue?
Does a mental link need any special item, such as two eggs, and does it reach creatures that have no way to speak at all?
Which binding stops a captive who is unable to act from teleporting or leaving for other planes, yet still lets them pass through a gateway?
How often can a captive bound by enchanted cuffs make a brute-force escape attempt, and what total of thirty or more breaks the cuffs?
When I'm battered in combat, which quick extra action restores 1d10 plus my level in health, and how often can I use it before resting?
After a brief breather, how many uses of my endurance surge return, and does that supply grow as I gain levels?
Which spell moves me and up to eight willing friends to a known spot in the same realm, with a random d100 roll deciding whether we land safely?
If I'm hauling a crate that's Large or smaller, can magic whisk it across the same realm, provided no unwilling creature is holding it?
Which levels grant a sneaky character a chance to boost their attributes or pick a talent, starting at level four and repeating later?
When my sneaky character reaches levels eight, ten, twelve, and sixteen, what choices do they get: a stat boost or any qualifying perk?
Which large heavenly guardian, immune to being beguiled and scared, always knows when it hears a lie and returns to life in its home realm if slain elsewhere?
What flying foe takes an edge on saves against spells and unleashes a light blast reaching 20 feet that hurts failing foes?
Which shapeshifting beast turns into an animal-humanoid mix or a plain animal, while the clothes and gear it carries stay the same?
Does a shapeshifter that becomes a large wild form gain better combat stats, or only extra bulk and size?
Which garment with watchful patterns grants seeing in darkness and piercing illusions out to 120 feet, but can blind me if someone casts a glow on it?
If a sunburst goes off within five feet of my magic garment, what difficulty must my toughness roll beat each turn to end the blindness?
Which casting ends a toxin-induced illness when I touch someone, and for an hour gives them an edge against toxins and halves toxic harm?
Can divine and wilderness spellcasters learn a second-level ward against toxins that lasts an hour?
Which hulking brute knocks foes off their feet with an axe, and whose spiked club leaves victims at a penalty on their next swing?
Is there a large creature with 8 nimbleness and 21 brawn that can't be blinded, deafened, or knocked out?
Which epic feat at level nineteen or higher lets my blunt, stabbing, and cutting strikes ignore half-damage defenses while raising Strength or Dexterity?
If my attack roll shows a natural twenty, how much bonus harm do I add, and what determines that amount?
Which large brute swings a long blade with 10-foot reach that deals life-draining harm, and can charge to skewer a foe and knock it flat?
How far must a charging brute move straight toward a target before its skewering attack gains bonus stabbing harm and a knockdown?
Which random magic effect conjures a rhinoceros, elephant, or rat that vanishes after an hour and doesn't obey me?
Which botanical toolset costs 5 gold and lets me tell what a leafy growth is with a DC 10 Intelligence check?
What can I craft with botanical gear, such as a healing draught, an antidote, a candle, or a medic's bag?
Which combat-focused class can use everyday and battle weapons, wear heavy armor and shields, and picks starting gear from three bundles?
If I want a warrior's starting kit with chain mail, a greatsword, and eight javelins, or 155 gold, which class offers that?
Which lofty spellcaster can make four raw magical blasts in one turn and, once a day, peer at distant places or jump across the map instantly?
Is there a caster with 170 hit points that gets an edge against spells and can blink short distances three times daily?
Which casting places an unseen sensor up to a mile away, letting me see or hear through it for ten minutes and flip between the two with a quick extra move?
If a creature can see through illusions and unseen things, what does my remote watcher look like to it, and how big?
Which top-tier sneaky ability turns a failed d20 roll into a natural 20, but only once until I take a short or long rest?
After a brief breather, can that top-tier sneaky ability turn another failed die check into a 20, or must I wait for a lengthier rest?
Which magic scepter lets me make creatures in view within 120 feet treat me as their trusted leader for eight hours, unless they win a DC 15 mental roll?
If I bend a creature to my will, then harm it or make it act against its nature, does its loyalty survive?
Which tall folk can pick one boon from towering ancestors, such as a 30-foot teleport hop or a thunder counterstrike when wounded?
If my training bonus is three, how many times can I use an ancestral boon, and when do those uses come back?
Which spell makes a spectral guard dog only I can see, barks at strangers who don't say a password, and bites nearby foes for 4d8 raw magical harm?
What spell needs a silver whistle and ends once the caster and the watcher are 300 feet apart?
Which huge winged reptile breathes a 60-foot line of acid for 12d8 harm, and can later halve a foe's speed with a cone of breath?
What acid-spewing flyer can choose to succeed on a failed roll three times per day, and when does its breath return after use?
My sneaky character keeps getting swarmed by brutes who want an edge on their swings. What high-level trick denies them that, unless I'm unable to act?
At what character level do foes lose the ability to get an edge on attacks against me, and what condition removes that protection?
Which Charisma-based gear lets me perform a known tune with a DC 10 roll or improvise a fresh song at DC 15, with options like lutes and drums?
How do the price and weight of a bag-blown wind instrument compare with a lute's?
Which pendant keeps me safe from knowledge-seeking spells and magical sensors peering in, unless I choose to let them?
How rare is a neck-worn charm that blocks spying magic, and do I need to bond with it before it works?
Which caster can cancel an enemy's spell or raise a magical barrier as a reaction, three times a day?
When an enemy begins casting, which mental strength does a caster use to answer with a counter-magic or barrier?
Which slimy blob burns anyone who strikes it up close, and can slide through a crack an inch wide while scaling ceilings?
Is there a gelatinous monster immune to cold, lightning, and slashing blows that can eat through two feet of wood or metal in a minute?
